description: Run prompts against AI answer engines through their public, logged-out interfaces and get, per engine and run, the answer text, whether the brand is mentioned and its position, competitors mentioned, cited URLs and domains and a sentiment label, plus per-prompt mention rate, share of voice and citation share with the sample size. Answers vary run to run, so set runs_per_prompt. Billed per successful engine answer only; an engine that needs login returns engine_unavailable_logged_out and is not billed. Use action=quote (or action=check with quote_only=true) to get the price first, and set hard_cap_microcents to refuse any run quoted above it. action=check (default) runs the check; action=status and action=results read a past run by run_id.

action.description: check (default) runs the prompts; quote prices them without running; status and results read a run by run_id.

brand.description: Brand to look for (check and quote).

brand_domains.description: Domains that count as the brand when cited. Default: none.

competitors.description: Competitor names to track. Default: none.

country.description: Country code for localised answers. Default: engine default.

hard_cap_microcents.description: Refuse the run if the quote exceeds this many microcents. Default: no cap.

quote_only.description: Return the quote without running or billing. Default: false.

run_id.description: Run id from a check (status and results).

runs_per_prompt.description: Runs per prompt and engine, 1-5. Default: 1.

name: alterlab_ai_visibility
title: AI Visibility Check
